_doc: Curated card lore notes for scripts/build_card_enrichment.py (Bot cycles 33–36, Phase 8, #100). Key = exact card name. relation: depicts | references | echoes (echoes = mechanics mirror a cited moment; guidance). Every note cites official (wizards.com) pages; every double-quoted passage must be verbatim in a cited cached page (checked by build_card_enrichment.py --check). flag: optional ⚠️ / 🚫.

Godsend.text: Heliod "reforged the sword into the spear Godsend"; Elspeth later "stabbed Xenagos with Godsend, destroying him once and for all"

Blackblade Reforged.text: the weapon the *Dominaria* (2018) heroes seek: "So this Blackblade would kill Belzenlok."

The Mightstone and Weakstone.text: the two halves of the stone the brothers split; *The Brothers' War* episode 5 ends with "Mightstone and Weakstone, reunited at last, within the surviving brother."

Helvault.text: Avacyn's prison: Griselbrand would "trap her in the Helvault", and "When the Helvault shattered, Avacyn emerged at her full strength."

The Immortal Sun.text: the Sun Empire's lost relic: "Emperor Apatzec Intli was gifted the Immortal Sun in a fateful encounter, and vowed to conquer the merfolk and raze the jungle."

Golgothian Sylex.text: the artifact behind the Sylex Blast; in *Dominaria* (2018) Karn says "It was created by Urza to help defeat the Phyrexians." Later stories give other origins (see the item entry's three statements)

Moonsilver Key.text: "the Sungold Lock in the center of the Celestus needs to be joined with an enchanted, blessed-silver item called the Moonsilver Key", and "the Moonsilver Key has been lost for generations"

Crucible of the Spirit Dragon.text: "Narset and the other rebellion leaders gathered at the remains of the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon, hoping to finally put an end to the dragonlords' reign."

Hedron Archive.text: Zendikar's hedrons: "Ancient, rune-carved monoliths called hedrons are strewn across Zendikar."

The World Tree.text: Kaldheim's World Tree: "Looming overhead is the unfathomably huge bulk of the World Tree, whose dangling roots plunge into the realm." (Istfell)

Halo Fountain.text: New Capenna's Halo: the archangels "gave themselves up to make Halo, to distribute it across the city and throughout the air itself"

Halo Forager.text: New Capenna's Halo: the archangels "gave themselves up to make Halo, to distribute it across the city and throughout the air itself"

Settle the Score.text: Liliana ends Belzenlok with the Blackblade in the scene captioned with the card: "Liliana leapt forward, under Belzenlok's arm, and seized the Blackblade's hilt", "using her body to pull the demon's life force into the blade."

In Bolas's Clutches.text: the close of *Dominaria* (2018), captioned with the card: "Sick at heart, bound like a prisoner to a new incarnation of a fate she had schemed so long to cheat, Liliana followed in his wake."

Vraska's Contempt.text: Vraska saves Jace from a vampire captain on Ixalan: "She shoved herself between him and Jace"; "The vampire's skin and clothes turned to stone in her grip."

Deadlock Trap.text: Chandra fails to burn through a Consulate seal: "a blue-white light flared with a crack like a whip and Chandra staggered backward into Nissa's arms"

Oath of Kaya.text: Kaya's oath after the War of the Spark: "For the living and the dead, I will keep watch."

Unlikely Aid.text: Gideon rides Rakdos during the War of the Spark battle: "And then I spotted Mister Jura, riding atop the demon's head."

Gideon's Intervention.text: the Amonkhet scene captioned with the card, where Samut times an intervention against Hazoret's spear: "Samut dug in her heel and loosened her stance, charging a spell of speed and timing her impending intervention as Hazoret's spear pulled back."

Mastermind's Acquisition.text: Vraska follows the thaumatic compass in the scene captioned with the card: "She pulled out the thaumatic compass and, sure enough, the needle pointed upward."

Assemble the Players.text: Story Spotlight for Murders at Karlov Manor Episode 8: "Proft calls a meeting of the guild leaders, and one by one, they arrive at Vitu-Ghazi."

Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core.text: Story Spotlight for The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Episode 4: the Sun Empire team and the vampire expedition "now stand before Matzalantli, the great door."

Huatli's Final Strike.text: Story Spotlight for The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Episode 6: "Huatli took up the lance wrested from Vito and stabbed him through the heart, pinning him to the ground."
